name: Usami Yun
source:
Grade: Junior high school 1st grader.
Room: Megae Dorm, Room 301.
Characteristics: Yun's appearance and personality is like that of an elementary school student's. She loves stuffed toys, especially her toy rabbit which she carries around with her at all times.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080331225921/http://www.kid-game.co.jp/kid/game/game_galkid/milky/chara.html]official site[/url].]
